description.narrative:
Project Outcomes. Stakeholder effects: The Project is expected to support increased access to climate finance for SMEs and large corporates in Türkiye. By supporting the expansion of TEB Arval's green vehicle (GV) fleet, consisting of electric (EVs) and hybrid vehicles (HEVs), the Project is expected to enable greater access to GV leasing, which is not widely available in the Turkish leasing market, for SMES and corporate clients.
Market Outcomes. Sustainability: The Project is a part of IFC's programmatic approach with Turkish NBFIs which aims to deepen the adoption of climate finance standards, products, and practices by leasing companies and other NBFIs in the Turkish market, including through the enhancement of these practices reflected in various advanced sustainability products, adoption of sustainability frameworks, and public reporting on sustainable finance, and other best practices.

The proposed investment is a senior loan package of up to US$50 million equivalent in Turkish Lira to TEB Arval Arac Filo Kiralama A.S. (TEB Arval or the Company). The financing is to be used exclusively for financing the Companys acquisition of sustainable transport assets, including both EVs and Hybrid Vehicles and accessory charging stations.
